description_en: Includes subscription consistency checks, consumption TPS statistics, load balancing status, and consumer connections
description_zh: 包含订阅关系检查、消费 TPS 统计、负载均衡状态、消费端连接等
kebab_example: aliyun sofa get-mq-sofamq-consumer-status --cell RZ01A --detail true --group-id GID_test_group_id --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --need-jstack false --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMqSofamqConsumerStatus

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query detailed information. Valid values:
- true: Query detailed information.
- false: Do not query detailed information
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询详细信息。取值说明如下：true：要查询详细信息；false：不查询详细信息
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en: The Group ID of the consumer to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的消费端 Group ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID that corresponds to the Group ID to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to print Jstack information
parameters.help_zh: 是否打印 Jstack 信息
parameters.name: need_jstack
